messages:
maya: Heads-up  new webinar concept: "Embargoed Bench + Live Labs". Goal = hard launch of bench numbers to press + hands-on breakout labs for engineers. Thoughts?
elliot: Strong. We need an embargo date and a PR-safe narrative. recommend 'expected savings' language until infra validation completes.
priya: Speaker pool: finance-led ROI 2min, compliance/regulatory 3min (GDPR note), customer case (EMEA) 8min. Can get localization for FR/ES if needed.
sam: Demo plan: 12m live demo + 3 parallel 10m labs. Labs require temporary creds and a short terraform snippet. Need 20m prod-like smoke with synthetic load. Wed or Thu windows open.
zoe: Ops: registrants -> HubSpot list "embargoed_bench_launch"; attended -> property webinar_attended=true; clicked-cta -> tag "webinar_trial". Hot leads (clicked trial + asked demo) -> SDR high-priority. ops-bot: automation queued.
maya: RoS (55m): 1m housekeeping, 5m embargo narrative + top-line stat (provisional), 8m customer story, 12m demo, 15m labs (parallel), 10m panel + CTAs. embargoed slide must be watermarked.
elliot: For press safety, add slide with "validation context" (dataset, seq len, batching) and mark stats provisional until final validation timestamp.
priya: Compliance: need a short script for the customer to avoid divulging sensitive PII. I'll draft and send to legal. Also confirm any data residency notes for EMEA customer.
sam: Rehearsals: book 30m tech smoke + 25m content run two days before. I can do Wed 09:30 PT smoke. Josh (ops) likely to run fallback clip.
zoe: Post-event flow: 1) immediate recording to registrants (embargo reminder for press), 2) 6h SDR outreach for hot leads, 3) add engaged attendees to nurture + lab invite. UTM: utm_campaign=embargo_bench_launch_2026.
maya: Social assets: 30s demo clip, 15s social soundbite for X, and a 1-page bench narrative for press. Elliot, can you draft the press blurb?
elliot: Yep. Will prepare provisional blurb with clear caveats and a validation ETA.
ops-bot: Reminder set: upload embargoed deck + watermark by Tue 18:00 PT; rehearse Wed 09:30 PT; content run Fri 16:00 PT; webinar Mon 11:00 PT.
priya: Volunteers to moderate Q&A? Need someone to route compliance questions to legal and product bugs to #eng-oncall.
maya: Priya will triage compliance, Sam will handle demo triage, Zoe will coordinate SDR handoff. :thumbsup:
maya: Great. Keep critical updates here and avoid posting embargo details elsewhere.
